_meta.source: FIFA/Coca-Cola Men's World Ranking. Captured from Wikipedia / ESPN.
_meta.next_edition_note: The launch forecast is LOCKED to the 1 April 2026 edition per PM policy 2026-06-03 (see scripts/ingest_fifa_rankings.py); FIFA's next edition (2026-06-11, kickoff day) is NOT used for the launch forecast and may only enter post-launch as a normal admin update.
usage_in_simulator: Step 3g of Article 13 (within-group tie-breaker terminal step) — use the latest available edition; for the locked launch forecast that is the 1 April 2026 edition.
Step 3h of Article 13 — if a tie survives 3g, fall back to the FIFA edition(s) immediately before 1 April 2026 (going backward in time). April 2026 is the launch/latest edition, not the fallback.
Same chain for best-third ranking (no head-to-head, but FIFA Ranking is the final fallback).

top_50_april_2026._note: Did NOT qualify for 2026 — lost playoff to Bosnia. Listed here only for completeness.

_incomplete_data_notice: Only the top 20 are captured here. Claude Code should pull the full top-50 (and ideally all 48 qualified teams) from Wikipedia or FotMob into the database. The 'team' field needs alias-mapping to the canonical 2026 team names in teams_2026.csv (e.g., 'South Korea' vs 'Republic of Korea').
claude_code_tasks: Day 2: Pull the complete April 1, 2026 ranking (all 211 FIFA-ranked teams or at minimum all 48 qualified teams) into a CSV/JSON.
Day 2: Pull at least one earlier edition (Jan 2026 or older) for the step-3h fallback chain. Older editions are useful as well for the Article 13 step 3h going-backward-in-time logic.
Launch: the launch ranking is LOCKED to the 1 April 2026 edition (already captured); do not pull a new edition for launch; the 2026-06-11 (kickoff-day) edition is post-launch only.
Throughout: store with edition_date in the DB so the simulator can identify 'latest' vs 'previous'.

sanity_check.for_elo_validation: When Phase 2.1 builds the in-house Elo from the historical results, the top-10 Elo teams should overlap with the top-10 FIFA-ranked teams above (modulo Italy, who didn't qualify). If overlap is <7/10, the Elo computation has a bug.
